items.claim: CEO 給 Q3 EBITDA 財測 8.3 億美元±500 萬。
items.quote: EBITDA of $830 million, plus or minus $5 million;
items.speaker: John Plant

items.claim: CEO 給全年 EBITDA 財測 32.3 億美元±2000 萬（全年財測再度上調）。
items.quote: EBITDA of $3.23 billion, plus or minus $20 million,
items.speaker: John Plant

items.claim: CEO 表示自由現金流對淨利轉換率維持 90% 目標。
items.quote: is maintained at our 90% target conversion
items.speaker: John Plant

items.claim: CEO 預告 11 月 Q3 法說首度提供 2027 營收展望，預期高於 2026。
items.quote: which we expect will be an increase over 2026
items.speaker: John Plant

items.claim: CEO 預期年底槓桿回到約 1 倍淨負債/EBITDA。
items.quote: 1x net debt-to-EBITDA by year-end
items.speaker: John Plant

items.claim: CEO 報告 Q2 EBITDA 利潤率 32.1%，年增 340bp（含 CAM 併入）。
items.quote: EBITDA margin in Q2 was 32.1%, an increase of 340
items.speaker: John Plant

items.claim: CFO 說明 Engine Products 利潤率年增 470bp 至 37.7%。
items.quote:
EBITDA margin
increased 470 basis points to 37.7%
items.speaker: Patrick Winterlich

items.claim: CFO 拆解 Forged Wheels：鋁價轉嫁稀釋利潤率約 360bp，但 EBITDA 金額無實質影響。
items.quote: diluted margins by approximately 360 basis points
items.speaker: Patrick Winterlich

items.claim: CFO 表示 Wheels 利潤率被稀釋的情況預期至少再持續幾季。
items.quote: likely to continue at least for the next couple of quarters
items.speaker: Patrick Winterlich

items.claim: CEO 以 CAM 約 20%、自家約 30% 的利潤率說明併購稀釋被原有業務提升所抵銷。
items.quote: they were a 20% company, so we were at 30%
items.speaker: John Plant

items.claim: CEO 說 CAM 綜效大部分落在 2027。
items.quote: the majority of it comes in 2027
items.speaker: John Plant

items.claim: CEO 表示 CAM 對 EPS 今年約持平，2027 起轉為正貢獻。
items.quote: starting to see positive EPS effect in 2027 and beyond
items.speaker: John Plant

items.claim: CEO 將 2027 定為 CAM 最佳化計畫的重點年。
items.quote: to begin to drive noticeable synergies
items.speaker: John Plant

items.claim: CEO 說今年資本支出將超過 5 億美元，2027 還要再增加。
items.quote: already seeing the need to further increase this in 2027
items.speaker: John Plant

items.claim: CFO 說明資本支出有客戶合約支持。
items.quote: Investments are backed by customer contracts.
items.speaker: Patrick Winterlich

items.claim: CEO 預期 2027 回購金額多於 2026。
items.quote: we'll probably buy back more stock than we
items.speaker: John Plant

items.claim: CEO 預期未來 12 個月股利不會再大幅調整（剛調升 17%）。
items.quote: I doubt we'll do much by way of change on the dividend
items.speaker: John Plant

items.claim: CEO 表示願意考慮進一步併購。
items.quote: I think we have a willingness to examine further M&A
items.speaker: John Plant

items.claim: CEO 表示目前不預期超大型併購。
items.quote: I'm not envisaging at this point anything mega large
items.speaker: John Plant

items.claim: CEO 說 Howmet 在工業燃氣輪機（IGT）葉片全球市占逾 50%。
items.quote: market share in excess of 50% globally for turbine blades
items.speaker: John Plant

items.claim: CEO 認為新應用與新產品導入將使市占進一步提高。
items.quote: leads us to believe that our market share will
items.speaker: John Plant

items.claim: CEO 說已與 7 大 IGT 客戶中最後一家完成談判。
items.quote: completed negotiations with the last of our 7 major customers
items.speaker: John Plant

items.claim: CEO 說 IGT 營收成長超出他原先預期，主因是既有資產良率改善。
items.quote: exceeded what I thought we would possibly do
items.speaker: John Plant

items.claim: CEO 說日本新廠產能幾乎已被預訂完。
items.quote: fully spoken for. We have one casting pit left
items.speaker: John Plant

items.claim: CEO 預期 IGT 成長將持續未來 4–5 年。
items.quote: we will see growth throughout the next 4 or 5 years
items.speaker: John Plant

items.claim: CEO 說商用航空需求未因中東衝突改變。
items.quote: Howmet has not experienced any changes in customer demand.
items.speaker: John Plant

items.claim: CFO 指出備件占營收比重高於歷史水準。
items.quote: a greater portion of our total revenue than historically
items.speaker: Patrick Winterlich

items.claim: CFO 指出北美商用卡車輪圈量較上季回升 7%。
items.quote: on a sequential basis, wheels volumes were up 7%
items.speaker: Patrick Winterlich

items.claim: CEO 說緊固件已開始看到 787 等寬體機的拉貨。
items.quote: We are beginning to see the pull.
items.speaker: John Plant

items.claim: CEO 說 LEAP-1A/1B 新技術葉片切換預期較可能在 2027 年第一季，日期未定。
items.quote: first quarter of 2027. But again, date not fixed
items.speaker: John Plant

items.claim: CEO 說今年下半年 GTF Advantage 仍以舊版葉片全量供應。
items.quote: the legacy blade at pretty full volumes
items.speaker: John Plant

items.claim: CEO 說多化學成分塗層擴產，並傾向擴建 Whitehall 廠區。
items.quote: it's probably more likely than not
items.speaker: John Plant

items.claim: CEO 說上週簽核商用航空新廠興建。
items.quote: the building of a new plant in that area as well.
items.speaker: John Plant

items.claim: CEO 表示不願為單一年度高峰而投資，需持續監控需求的可持續性。
items.quote: we don't want to certainly invest for a singular year peak
items.speaker: John Plant

items.claim: CEO 說國防備件需求增加預期在 2027，尚無具體訂單。
items.quote: a 2027 items that is anticipated but not assured
items.speaker: John Plant

items.claim: CEO 說飛彈增產目前尚無正式同意的增加訂單。
items.quote: we have nothing formally agreed by way of increased orders
items.speaker: John Plant

items.claim: CEO 評論太空資料中心的威脅預計落在 2040–2050 年代。
items.quote: sometime in the 2040s or maybe in 2050s
items.speaker: John Plant

items.claim: CEO 對商用卡車輪圈說外部預測機構預期 2027 更強。
items.quote: envisaging an even stronger 2027
items.speaker: John Plant

qa_flags.response_pattern: 未給具體產能或速率數字，改談新機種時程不確定與需求可持續性，稱需增產的程度「yet to be determined」。

qa_flags.response_pattern: 未提供利用率數字或季增指引，只說部分機台仍在爬升、還有設備待進。
